stem:
Reyansh is completing a mirror image across a fixed vertical symmetry line. Point $A$ is $3\,\mathrm{cm}$ to the left of the line, at a marked height.

Which two claims correctly place the reflected point $A'$?

options.text: $A'$ is the name mirror image for the symmetry line itself.
$A'$ is $3\,\mathrm{cm}$ to the right of the line, at the same height as $A$.
$A'$ and $A$ are the same distance from the symmetry line, on opposite sides.
First place $A'$, and that placement is what creates the symmetry line.

teacher.key_rationale: Reflection keeps equal distance from the line on the opposite side at the same height. B and C state that. Naming the line as A' or saying A' creates the line reverses or swaps the roles.
